status: Declared before executing the orbit comparisons
purpose: Validate the bar-aware orbital forward calculation before fitting or scoring stellar populations
pattern_speed_status: Magnitude adopted from the pinned Hunter24 AGAMA example, sign positive in our prograde coordinate convention; not fitted or uniquely measured
bar_frame: Right-handed Cartesian, bar major axis x, prograde positive Lz; p is inertial velocity expressed in the rotating axes
initial_conditions: Six synthetic probes: R=1,3,8 kpc, z=0.1,0.8 kpc, azimuth=pi/6; vR=20, vz=20 km/s, vphi=0.8 times the initial ordinary-matter radial circular-speed diagnostic. Identical Cartesian states across models. These are not six observed stars or an equilibrium population.
refinement_after_initial_failure: Initial ordinary-matter run differed by 0.0001503 kpc and 0.03493 km/s between tolerances, exceeding the unchanged acceptance thresholds. Retain those failed results; if either refinement threshold fails, compare 2e-11 against 2e-13 and retain the latter. A verified shared-Legendre evaluator accelerates the same potential without changing coefficients or equations. The first slow run was stopped deliberately after this evidence, not assumed dead from lack of output.
field_accuracy: Existing bar L40 and nuclear L16 caches; disk order 24 remains provisional. Compare L24 and L40 orbital summaries separately. Orbit-integrator success is not proof of field convergence or astrophysical accuracy.
domain_revision: Initial disk interpolation R=0.05 to 40 kpc failed when an orbit left its domain. Extend to R=0.001 to 40 kpc with proportionally more radial nodes, retain z=-10 to 10 kpc and all initial conditions, durations and acceptance thresholds. Never extrapolate silently.
holdout_policy: No stellar velocities or validation/test scores loaded. No optimization of synthetic deposit amplitudes. Existing stellar splits remain unchanged.
hypothesis_scope: Known Newtonian orbital equations plus earlier synthetic deposit-potential additions. No new derivation of capture, energy supply, photon origin or lensing. Standard halo is a comparison only.
